Our employees' thoughts...

Allen Beers
Class 1 Driver – 22 Years of service

Scotia Recycling is a great company to work for. I have been here 22 years and have seen a lot of changes but safety has always been the #1 priority. The company cares about its people and that is means a lot.

Josephine White
Supervisor – 24 years of service

At first it was just a job but as the years went by I realized there was a lot to do in regards to recycling, but we are getting there! I met a lot of great people and some becoming good friends.

Holly O’Neill
HR Business Partner – 5 years of service

When I started at Scotia Recycling, I was hired for a payroll position, but I have done so much more. Thanks to my managers' and colleagues' support I've been able to take on a new broader position, challenging projects, develop new skills, and take my career to the next level.
